title: Shiraishi An — Those Precious To Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Plaza
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Rin! Miku! Sorry for the wait!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey there, An.
You didn't have to come running.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I'm the one who invited you to practice, so I can't go being late.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew I could count on you, An! Unlike a certain KAITO I could name.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, it's rare to see you running late in general.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I was over at Weekend Garage until just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All our regulars went on about how quiet the place would be without me, and I just couldn't get away.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, our trip to the US will be a bit on the long side, but it's not like we're never coming back home.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That just goes to show how much they all care about you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess so!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, the US...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's going to be so much fun! Think you'll get to see a lot of the sights?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm, well, since we'll be over there, I'd like to, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, no...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I just remembered that they always told me Aunt Nagi was away in the US.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't know if it was just because Uncle Taiga was over there, or if there was someplace over there she really wanted to visit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you don't know yourself, I guess you'll just have to ask your dad, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll message him once we—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Did you see something flash down at the end of that alley just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I did! It looked like a fragment of a feeling!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's check it out.
se_walk_women_001_4
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look, there! This has to be it, right? It looks sort of like a shard of glass.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It looks similar to a fragment of a feeling, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's something weird about it, though. It's all broken.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's strange that Miku and I never noticed this...
How long has it been here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, we can't just leave the poor thing here. This is someone's precious feelings, after all. Let's pick it up...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?! What was that?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right, I totally forgot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Touching those brings you into the feeling's SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right. We'll go back in a little while, so it shouldn't be dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it looks like practice is canceled for now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha... Sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place sure is quiet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's true. There's a stage set up, and a DJ booth and speakers and all sorts of audio equipment, and yet...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah! An, look! Look here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Look! There's a picture of you when you're little having fun playing with turntables!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're right! Is this a photo? I feel like our photo album at home has a picture like this in it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are more pictures over here, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, this is from when Kohane and I went to PXL with the others! The one Haruka took! It has to be!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And this is one of the ones Kohane took when we went camping!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The pictures of you when you were small are mixed in with the others. See, there's another one there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. This was a festival at that shrine near Vivid Street, I think. I caught goldfish with some of the locals.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that picture of me eating snacks has to be from the time Uncle Taiga brought me a bunch of...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's weird...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... We found this feeling's SEKAI by chance, but there are so many pictures of you here, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, that's one thing, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look, the turntables picture, the goldfish picture, the candy picture...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why am I the only one in those pictures?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The folks from Vivid Street and Aunt Nagi should be in those, too.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Huh?
That's because we don't need any of them, duh.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Who's there?!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? No way...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's the little An from the pictures?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you mean, we don't need any of them?

rows.Speaker: An?
rows.Line: Because we don't need any of them, that's why.

rows.Speaker: An?
rows.Line: They're all liars...

rows.Speaker: An?
rows.Line: Even Aunt Nagi left me all by myself...

rows.Speaker: An?
rows.Line: Hey, let's just forget all about them. They're all so selfish and mean.

rows.Speaker: An?
rows.Line: Then we won't have to be sad anymore.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah, An!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! An, you're okay—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, Rin.
Something's different.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, An?! Where are you going?!
AAAHH!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow! Oh my gosh! This is awesome!
You're Kagamine Rin, right?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that's Hatsune Miku, right?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but... An, what—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi! I'm An Shiraishi! Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It seems like... She's forgotten about us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whaaat?!
